label: Avito Advertising (Авито Реклама)
terms_note: Create API keys (Client Key / Secret) in the account settings — Admin role required; SDKs for PHP 7.4+, Python 3, Go, TypeScript; points-based rate limits per method, reset weekly (Mondays UTC+0). Free.

discovery.auth: api_key (Client Key / Secret created in account settings by an Admin → token)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (public API for bids, budgets, statistics, accounts; no campaign creation) Confidence: **high** — official help page read.
auth: 1. An Admin creates Client Key / Client Secret in the cabinet settings.
2. Exchange for a token (`POST /token`, client_credentials — TODO(verify)); `Authorization: Bearer`.
3. Agencies create nested (дочерние) accounts on the same contract and invite users with roles Администратор / Для просмотра.

endpoints.call: balance (rubles + bonuses) · transfers between parent / child accounts
list campaigns / groups / creatives with statuses and settings
change bid and budget for a creative group
statistics per campaign / group / creative, 1–90 days, day / week / month breakdown
endpoints.notes: spend, clicks, impressions, CTR, CPC, CPM, VTR

endpoints.call: campaign / group / creative creation · audiences upload · conversions

reference.limits: - Points-based limits per method, reset weekly (Monday 00:00 UTC); free; Avito Advertising terms; ОРД labelling handled via contracts endpoints.
mcp_sdk: Official SDKs: PHP 7.4+, Python 3, Go, TypeScript.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client Key created by an Admin in the Avito Advertising cabinet settings (API keys); exchanged at POST https://api.avito.ru/token (grant_type=client_credentials, form body) for a bearer token.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The matching Client Secret. Tokens are re-requested automatically on expiry or 401.

config_fields.name: account_id
config_fields.help: Numeric Avito Advertising account id (every path is /ads/v1/account/{account_id}/…); used by `me`.

me.note: GET /ads/v1/account/{account_id}: legal details of the configured account (inn, shortName, longName, contact, manager). Endpoint per Avito's official SDK (linked from https://ads-help.avito.com/external/api; the developers.avito.ru reference blocks non-Russian IPs).

list_accounts.note: GET /ads/v1/account/{account_id}/children: the child (nested) accounts on the configured account's contract (agencies). The parent account itself is `me`. Balances are in raw only on the /children-with-balances variant, which is not called; currency is RUB.

list_campaigns.note: POST /ads/v1/account/{account_id}/campaigns {filter: {statuses: [status]}, limit (1–100), page}. status values: draft, in_moderation, moderation_failed, partial_moderation, active, paused, stopped, finished, archived. `budget` is an integer as returned (RUB). Endpoint and body per Avito's official SDK (the developers.avito.ru reference blocks non-Russian IPs).

get_report.note: POST /ads/v1/account/{account_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}/stats {dateFrom, dateTo} (YYYY-MM-DD; the help page allows 1–90 days): daily points of one campaign (views → impressions, clicks, ctr, spend and spendBonus in RUB, cpm, cpc). campaign_id is REQUIRED (statistics are per campaign; the same response also carries per-group and per-creative breakdowns, left in the platform response and not mapped). Each call costs API points (weekly balance).

not_offered.update_budget: Budgets are set per creative group, not per campaign: POST /ads/v1/account/{account_id}/group/{group_id}/change-budget {budget} (https://github.com/avito-tech/avito-ads-sdk-python3/blob/HEAD/avito_ads/_core/operations.py, change_group_budget); the API has no campaign-budget call.
not_offered.pause_resume: No status-change endpoint: the API lists campaigns/groups/creatives and changes group bids and budgets only ('Изменять ставку и бюджет группы', https://ads-help.avito.com/external/api).

evidence: host api.avito.ru: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (GlobalSign nv-sa)
probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 0/4 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages, 1 by their last segments; every parameter and body key named on the page
